name: CruciFix Me
source:
You are a vampire hunter in this noir tale, and tonight you are confronting a suspect to determine if your hunch is correct. Your suspect is a priest at a local church. How he is able to walk among those holy halls is the question. 

Will you kill an innocent human or be victorious in your investigation? Or will you fail, and succumb to something else entirely...

[From [url=https://saphfxre.itch.io/crucifix-me]Itch.io[/url]]
